title: Zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks
place_text: park along a wash near Barth's home

tellings.quote: gave back to me and it goes it starts into a zigzag

plain: On the Fourth of July in 2000, during the fireworks at a park along a wash near his home, Richard Barth saw a light that began to move in a zigzag. Barth, a former nuclear missile guard who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels he saw it himself, and a man named Roger comes up in his telling.
